request.deadline: instantly performed as part of the governance action's enactment on-chain
deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of treasury funds to the intended recipient as part of enactment
request.what: Reimburse the deposit allegedly lost by the submitter of the Ikigai Info governance action, plus compensation for staking rewards.

claims.claim: The Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 shortly after the Chang hard fork introduced on-chain governance.
The Ikigai Info governance action was symbolic and asked the community whether they agreed with a statement thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
A Cardano node bug permitted an unregistered stake key to be used in the governance action, preventing the submitter from recovering a 100,000 ADA deposit.
The proposal requests 103,000 ADA, consisting of the original 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA for lost staking rewards calculated at 2% per annum.
The proposer states there was significant community sentiment at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The Cardano in Oceania initiative included this reimbursement in its budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposer states the recipient of this reimbursement has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposer states the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal references an AdaStat governance page for the earlier governance action.
The proposer states there are no costs, expenses, audit budget, administrator custody requirements, or refund circumstances associated with this withdrawal.

summary: The proposal asks for 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse an unnamed Ikigai Info governance action submitter for an allegedly unrecoverable 100,000 ADA deposit plus 3,000 ADA in lost staking rewards, but most key factual and treasury-stewardship claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the document.
